outcome: Give Tech teams a working Product-Led Growth — Usage Analytics, Churn & Expansion Engine capability on their own data — it lifts trial-to-paid activation by ~30-40% and net revenue retention.
overview: Silent churn is only visible at renewal, by which time the account is already gone, and expansion is timed by account-manager intuition rather than by what customers actually do in the product. This engine turns product telemetry into three scores per account, covering activation, churn risk and expansion propensity, and feeds them to onboarding flows, in-product nudges and the customer-success queue with the usage evidence behind each one. It suggests a play; a human still owns the outreach and the commercial conversation. A four-to-five week build on real event data proves whether the signal exists in this product, and gives growth, product and success teams one shared view instead of three.
